provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data excluded. Commercial mixed-use vertical retained.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A single-face illuminated wall cabinet with a routed-and-backed aluminum face behind a translucent polycarbonate lens, deep U-channel frame, mounted off battens on plywood/Hardie blocking with a deliberate air gap.
knowledge.rationale: A reinforced deep U-channel frame and battened air-gap mount handle a wide cabinet on fiber-cement siding without compressing it; routed-and-backed face gives even lit copy.

structure.construction: 10x2.6in 6063-T52 aluminum U-channel, mitered/welded, 1.5in aluminum angle mounting bars, 1/8in aluminum back

routed aluminum face backed with translucent material, 0.150in translucent white polycarbonate lens, 1.5in aluminum angle face frame, 0.063in pre-finished white aluminum LED baffle, 12V 6000K white LEDs
off battens on 3/4in exterior plywood blocking + 5/16in Hardie board with air gap, qty 12 1/2x6in SS lag bolts

craft_observations: Deliberate air-gap detail off batten siding prevents compression of fiber-cement.
Deep reinforced U-channel handles the wide single-face cabinet.
